dialogue.t: Welcome back.
But it's not time for a drawn-out, deeply emotional, tearful goodbye just yet... After all, you haven't finished your tour of my little lodge.
But Paimon could swear we've been in all the rooms already?
Well, I never actually said there were no secret hidden rooms, did I? Us mages like our little fancies, you know — you should be used to this by now!
This way, if you please.
As one of the fixed observation points for changes in the world, I require it to have excellent visibility. Just as a sculptor needs a chisel, a writer needs both pen and ink...
My achievements in those two fields of art may well be up for debate, but when it comes to my main line of work, I take things very seriously indeed.
The "fate" of Teyvat has been shaken more and more frequently as of late. I'm sure you've felt it too, {NICKNAME}.
Sometimes I can't help but think, if I still had the form, power, and abilities I once possessed, I'd be able to do so much more than I can right now.
But I soon shake those thoughts from my head. If things were how they were before, I'd have so many more restrictions placed on me by the heavens.
The thought of having that many things I can't even talk about makes it seem like a terrible trade-off. I mean, how would I tell stories without the freedom to say what I want?
That's why I've never once regretted the price I paid, or any of the choices I've taken.
I wanted to become human, to live like a regular person... but such a life is a luxury. I can't forget that I am an angel.
Even if I were stuck being an angel in silence, I'd still fulfill my duties — defending civilization, defending life...
Oh dear, have I started talking too seriously again? Perhaps it's because of where we are...
I'm actually quite happy with my angelic side. You could even say I'm proud of it.
So you should be! You don't get involved much, but when you do, we all know we're in safe hands.
You really feel that way? Hehe, as long as you see me as someone to rely on, then I know I'm doing a fantastic job!
It's getting late. Here, take my blessings and continue on your adventure.
Never be afraid of losing your way, and never forget you have an angel watching over you.
I understand if you want to stay a while. After all, the scenery here exists only in my memories — you won't find it anywhere else.
